in_sanskrit.name: जलु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: mercury (as a planet) or ocean or reddish-brown (in color)

in_marathi.name: Jalu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jalu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jalu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jal’, meaning water or wave. In Hindu mythology, Jalu is a name of Lord Shiva, symbolizing the gentle and powerful flow of the universe.

in_bengali.name: Jalu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Gentle Wave
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jalu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jalu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘jal’, meaning water or wave. In Hindu mythology, Jalu is a name of Lord Shiva, symbolizing the gentle and powerful flow of the universe.
